description: Your own product's Google Search Console data — total clicks and impressions and the top search queries — as of its last sync into nooticr, not a live Search Console call. Use it to see whether people search for what your social content is about. Returns a message rather than an error when nothing has been synced; connect Search Console in API Connections first. Takes appId (optional when your workspace has only one product). No cost to call.

appId.description: Your product's id. Omit only with a single-app workspace.

name: get_search_console_data

error.description: Search Console's own error at the last sync, when it refused.

synced_at.description: When nooticr last synced this. Not live: say this date when quoting it.

title: Get Search Console Data
